[Wang Shi Long]
Hm? Aren't you a customer? I am Wang Shi Long, the chef of this restaurant.

[王世龙]
嗯？你是顾客吗？我是王世龙，这家餐厅的厨师。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
My family has served food to Lord Bai Long for a long time. This restaurant is own by my family and I am the successor.
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
我家世代为白龙大人提供美食。这家餐厅由我家经营，我是继承人。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Every dish my family cooks is counted among the most delicious food in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
我家烹制的每一道菜，都被誉为洛阳最美味的美食。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Our Dragon Soup won especially high praise from our Lord Bai Long.
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
我们的龙汤尤其受到了白龙大人的高度赞扬。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
I'm also proud to tell you that my family only uses the freshest, highest quality ingredients for our dishes.
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
我也很自豪地告诉您，我家只使用最新鲜、最高品质的食材来烹饪菜肴。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
We have been popular in Luoyang for hundreds and hundreds of years because of the quality of our gourmet food.
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
凭借美食的高品质，我们在洛阳已经红火了数百年。

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Recently, though, I've had a bad feeling that someone is trying to take over our restaurant...
scripts.translation:
[王世龙]
不过最近，我总觉得有人在试图接管我们的餐厅...

scripts.text:
[Wang Shi Long]
Oh, well. Maybe I'm in a different mood because of some other reason. It's probably nothing.
scripts.translation:

哦，算了。也许是因为别的原因心情不好。大概是我想多了。

of my Dragon Soup!

[Jiu Lian Bu]
Hey~
What's up?

[九连步]
嘿~
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I don't like hanging around too many people, so I came here. Listening to this stream really puts my mind at ease.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
我不喜欢在人多的地方待太久，所以来这里了。听着这流水声，心里真的很平静。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
No offense, but I'm upset
at the sheer number of tourists coming over to Luoyang. Sure, I can understand that our town is attractive and has beautiful sights.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
别误会，我只是对涌向洛阳的游客数量感到不满。虽然我能理解我们的城镇很有吸引力，风景也很美。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But I just can't stand crowds of people. People gather like sheep
to any place that they hear is popular, and that really bugs me!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
但我就是受不了人群。只要听说哪里热闹，人们就像羊群一样涌过去，这真的让我很烦躁！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Speaking of which, there's even
a place in Luoyang that's just like that. Man, I hate that restaurant!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
说到这个，洛阳甚至就有这么个地方。天哪，我讨厌那家餐厅！

scripts.text: What restaurant?
scripts.translation: 哪家餐厅？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
West of Luoyang, there's
a restaurant built on a pond. It's been around for a long time, selling food for ridiculous prices!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
洛阳西边，有一家建在池塘上的餐厅。它开了很久了，卖的东西价格高得离谱！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Oh sure, the food and flavors
there have a long history, but I don't think that justifies how they charge their patrons!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
没错，那里的食物和口味历史悠久，但我认为这不能成为他们漫天要价的理由！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
As a young man
who loves his town,
I can't let them manipulate my people like that!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
作为一个热爱自己城镇的年轻男子，我不能让他们这样摆布我的同胞！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But everyone here already knows who I am, so I can't do anything! I've already had one too many, shall we say, 'incidents' with the people living here already.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
但这里的人都认识我，所以我什么都做不了！我已经和这里的人发生过一些...“不愉快”的事件了。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I've been caught for tagging walls, shoplifting, scamming, stealing a few girlfriends... So yeah, I'm not exactly known as a sterling citizen.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
我因为涂鸦墙壁、偷窃、诈骗、甚至抢过别人的女朋友被抓过...所以，我并不是什么模范市民。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Say, wait a minute. The local people around here aren't too familiar with you. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
等等，这里的当地人似乎并不太熟悉你。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Would you sneak into that restaurant and steal the
^3131FFDragon Soup Broth^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
你能潜入那家餐厅，帮我偷出^3131FF龙汤底^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
The Dragon Soup Broth is the backbone for the restaurant
owner's secret recipe.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
龙汤底是这家餐厅老板秘密食谱的核心。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But they've been cheating their customers by watering that broth down and selling it for a ridiculous price! Serves them right if their secrets were stolen!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
但他们一直在掺水，然后以离谱的价格卖给顾客！如果他们的秘密被偷走了，那是他们活该！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
If you can steal some of the broth, I'll pay you back. So whaddya say?
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
如果你能偷到一些汤底，我会报答你的。怎么样？

scripts.text: I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 我去！

scripts.text: No, stealing is wrong.
scripts.translation: 不，偷窃是不对的。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]

I knew you'd
see things my way!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]

我就知道
你会站在我这边的！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Okay, the restaurant is at the West side of Luoyang. But you gotta be careful. The workers there watch over that broth like freakin' hawks!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
好的，餐厅在洛阳西边。但你得小心，那里的工人盯着那锅汤底，像鹰一样敏锐！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
When you finally steal the broth, make sure you bring it without spilling any. Okay? Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
等你偷到汤底后，一定要保证不洒出来带回来。好吗？祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]

You may have
a point there.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]

你倒是有几分道理。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
But then, that restaurant has been doing that to their customers for years! So, technically, we'd just be stealing back.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
不过话说回来，那家餐厅多年来一直在坑他们的顾客！所以从技术上讲，我们这算是偷回属于我们的东西。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
That joint isn't even that great. I mean, it's so obvious that they rip off their customers! Dragon Soup?! More like... Dragon Crap Soup!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
那家店其实也就那样。我是说，他们坑顾客简直太明显了！龙汤？！还不如叫...龙屎汤！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]

Whoa, I thought you were on your way to the restaurant. You better get a move on.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
咦...？
哇，我还以为你正赶去餐厅呢。你最好快点动身了。

[Jiu Lian Bu]

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Why don't you sit down and close your eyes, and feel that soothing wind. It's pretty refreshing...
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
坐下来，闭上眼睛，感受一下这舒缓的微风。感觉挺清爽的...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Also...
I'm a little
embarrassed to
say this but...
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
还有...
我有点
不好意思
说这个，但是...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
I'm the kind of guy who speaks his mind. If there's something you just wanna say, but can't, it's kind of like poison in your mind.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
我是个有话直说的人。如果你心里有什么话想说却说不出口，那就像心里藏着毒一样。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
You know what I'm talking about, right? If you bottle something up inside of you, it just causes you anxiety you don't need.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
你懂我的意思吧？把情绪憋在心里，只会让你产生不必要的焦虑。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So...
This is what you do.
Clench your fist, take
a deep breath.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
所以...
你要这样做。
握紧拳头，
深吸一口气。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
And just yell
whatever you want!
If you don't know
the words, just
screaming will do.
Let everything out!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
然后想喊什么就喊什么！
如果不知道说什么，
直接尖叫也没关系。
把一切都发泄出来！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Ready~!
Say it out loud!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
准备好了吗~！
大声喊出来！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So, how do you feel?
Don't you feel better now? Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
那么，感觉怎么样？
现在是不是感觉好多了？哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So from now on, whenever you
wanna relieve yourself of stress, come see me and we'll come back to this place. Call it my way of saying thanks.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
所以，以后每当你想释放压力，就来找我，我们会回到这个地方。就当是我表达感谢的方式吧。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So...
Whaddya wanna do?
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
那么...
你想做什么？

scripts.text: Shout.
scripts.translation: 大喊

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Alright~!
Say it out loud!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
好~！
大声喊出来！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
So, how do you feel? Don't you feel better now?
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
那么，感觉怎么样？现在是不是感觉好多了？

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Ahhh...
Alright, let's
get a groove on.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
啊哈...
好了，让我们
进入状态吧。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Hey, pal~! This is my turf! Whaddya think you're doin' here?!
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
嘿，伙计~！这是我的地盘！你以为你在干什么？！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Lian Bu]
Now...
Get the hell
outta here.
scripts.translation:
[九连步]
现在...
赶紧滚
出这里。

you find a large pot filled with dark, red liquid. What do you
want to do?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF在阴影之下，

and they busy chatting

scripts.translation:
^3131FF周围只有餐厅的员工，

scripts.text:
^3131FFThe restaurant is filled
with customers, and the
hustle and bustle of the
restaurant employees.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF餐厅里挤满了顾客，

scripts.text:

away from this restaurant
without getting caught...^000000
scripts.translation:

不被发现地离开这家餐厅...^000000

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
I used to be
an enthusiastic
martial artist.
scripts.translation:
[金伟灵]
我曾经是一名
充满热情的
武术家。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Although I became an
assistant chef for a living, I always think of myself as a martial artist first.
scripts.translation:
[金伟灵]
虽然我为了生计成为了厨师助手，但我始终认为自己是武术家。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
So, I decided to reflect the spirit of the martial arts into my cooking. We are often very busy when there are many customers.
scripts.translation:
[金伟灵]
所以，我决定将武术的精神融入烹饪中。当顾客很多时，我们通常非常忙碌。

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
When we're busy, I can use my martial arts to cook cuisine much more quickly! Hahaha~ Martial arts can be very practical!
scripts.translation:
[金伟灵]
当我们忙碌时，我可以用武术更快地烹饪菜肴！哈哈~武术非常实用！

scripts.text:

Waaa-!!!!
scripts.translation:
[金伟灵]
哇啊——！！

scripts.text:
[Jin Wei Ling]
Waaa Taaah-!!!!!
scripts.translation:

哇啊——塔啊——！！！！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

我会继续通过烹饪磨练我的武术！

^666666*Sigh*^000000 I am so disappointed. I came all the way down here to taste the food! I can't believe they don't sell it anymore!

[李敏]
^666666*叹气*^000000 我太失望了。我大老远跑下来就是为了尝尝这里的菜！真不敢相信他们不再卖了！

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
The worst part is that I'm already addicted to the taste! ^666666*Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
最糟糕的是，我已经对那个味道上瘾了！^666666*呜咽...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
Well, I don't really
live here in Luoyang.
Still, I come here often
enough to visit.
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
其实，我不住在洛阳。
不过，我还是经常来这里逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
I just returned
because I've got
a huge craving for the
food I tasted here
a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
我刚刚回来，
因为我很想念
之前在这里尝到的
那道菜。

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
For some reason, I can't forget it. I can't get it out of my mind!
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
不知为何，我忘不了它。它一直在我脑海里挥之不去！

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
The taste, the texture.
The sweetness, melting down into my mouth, and its tempting scent lingering on my lips...
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
那味道，那口感。
甜味在口中融化，诱人的香气萦绕在唇边...

scripts.text:
[Li Min]
Ummmmm...
Royal Jelly!
It makes my
mouth water~
scripts.translation:
[李敏]
唔唔唔...
蜂胶！
让我口水直流~

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Do you know what was this restaurant's best dish throughout all of its history? Dragon Soup!
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
你知道这家餐厅历史上最出名的菜是什么吗？龙汤！

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Its delicate taste comes from
a broth extracted from pure meat that does not contain any fat. So it's also a very popular diet food for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
它的美味来自于用纯瘦肉熬制的汤底，不含任何脂肪。所以它也是女士们非常喜欢的减肥食品。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
I'm not sure what happened,
but people say this restaurant no longer sells Dragon Soup.
Was it because of the price...?
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
我不确定发生了什么，
但人们说这家餐厅不再卖龙汤了。
是因为价格太贵吗...

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Do you know what's the best dish at this restaurant? It's Dragon Soup! They've been selling it here for as long as this restaurant has been around.
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
你知道这家餐厅最好的菜是什么吗？是龙汤！这家餐厅开业以来就一直卖它。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
Its delicate taste comes from
a broth extracted from pure meat that does not contain any fat. So it's also a very popular diet food for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
它的美味来自于用纯瘦肉熬制的汤底，不含任何脂肪。所以它也是女士们非常喜欢的减肥食品。

scripts.text:
[Liu Jia Lim]
It's tasty and really good for your health. Why don't you order a bowl? I've never known anyone to taste Dragon Soup and not love it!
scripts.translation:
[刘嘉林]
它美味又健康。何不点一碗尝尝？我从未见过有人尝过龙汤却不爱上的！

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
Dragon Soup is known for its spicy, yet sweet and refreshing taste.
scripts.translation:
[姜荣]
龙汤以其辛辣、甜美且清爽的味道而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
It's made with all sorts of medicinal herbs, so it's good
for your health as well.
scripts.translation:
[姜荣]
它由各种草药制成，所以对身体也很有益。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
Dragon Soup draws out the unnecessary heat created inside
the body and circulates the blood. So it helps optimize the body's functions and promotes longevity.
scripts.translation:
[姜荣]
龙汤能排出体内多余的热气，促进血液循环。因此它有助于优化身体机能，延年益寿。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Rong]
I've eaten Dragon Soup regularly ever since I was young. Look at me, don't you think I look so healthy considering my age?
scripts.translation:
[姜荣]
我从小就一直喝龙汤。看看我，以我的年纪来说，是不是看起来很健康？

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
I don't feel good...
So... Totally out of it...
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
我不舒服...
所以...完全没精神...

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
Oh, my aching body!
All my muscles are sore...
There's only one thing that could cure all of this agonizing... pain...
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
哦，我浑身酸痛！
我的肌肉都在疼...
只有一样东西能治愈这种痛苦的...疼痛...

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
Hey kid~!
You don't look like a local!
Why don't you follow the road ahead and check out the big restaurant?
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
嘿，小孩~！
你看起来不像本地人！
何不沿着前面的路去看看那家大餐厅？

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
The soup that they sell there is probably the healthiest food you can ever find.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
他们那里卖的汤，大概是你能找到的最健康的食物了。

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
I guess you could eat
some of that soup
for your health.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
我想你可以喝点那种汤，对身体好。

scripts.text:
[Chi Wu Ping]
You seem to need
that soup to ease
the fatigue of your
body and mind.
scripts.translation:
[池武平]
你似乎需要那种汤，来缓解身体和精神的疲劳。

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
There's a strange rumor going around that the restaurant is no longer selling Dragon Soup...
scripts.translation:
[九尺灵]
最近有个奇怪的传闻，说那家餐厅不再卖龙汤了...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
Do you think
my brother did
something bad again!?
I hope not! If he did...
What am I supposed to do?!
scripts.translation:
[九尺灵]
你觉得我哥哥又做了什么坏事吗！？
我希望没有！如果他真的做了...
我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
I'm worried about my brother.
He's young, rebellious and doesn't listen to anybody...
scripts.translation:
[九尺灵]
我很担心我哥哥。
他年轻、叛逆，而且不听任何人的话...

scripts.text:
[Jiu Chi Ling]
He just left the
house while he was
complaining about
that restaurant...
scripts.translation:
[九尺灵]
他刚才还在抱怨那家餐厅，
然后就离家出走了...

[Jiu Chi Ling]
^666666*Sigh~~*^000000
I'm not gonna let him
get away this time!
scripts.translation:
[九尺灵]
^666666*叹气~~*^000000
这次我绝对不让他得逞！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
There are many pressure points on the human body. Ever since ancient times, it has been believed that each pressure point was limited
to its role and functions.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
人体有很多穴位。自古以来，人们一直认为每个穴位都有其特定的作用和功能。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, as I studied and experimented with every pressure point, I came to the conclusion that the use of pressure points, depending on the circumstances,
can produce different results.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
然而，在我研究和实验了每一个穴位后，我得出了结论：根据情况的不同，穴位的使用会产生不同的效果。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Few pressure points tend to show the same symptoms, regardless of the problem. Most of the time, the effects of pressure points will differ depending on the body's health or the time of day.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
很少有穴位无论问题如何都表现出相同的症状。大多数时候，穴位的效果会根据身体的健康状况或一天中的时间而有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
For instance, the pressure point located on the upper side of navel is the most vulnerable point.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
例如，位于肚脐上方的穴位是最脆弱的部位。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
If pressed the wrong way, it can cause death. But between 5:15 am and 7:15 am, it's just a weak point.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
如果按压方式不当，可能会导致死亡。但在早上5:15到7:15之间，它只是一个弱点。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Being strong as a person is not defined as mere physical strength.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
一个人的强壮，并不仅仅定义为单纯的体力。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Factors such as intelligence, experience and knowledge are
also considered when judging one's strength.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
在判断一个人的强弱时，智力、经验和知识等因素也会被考虑在内。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Let's say you're very strong and given the most powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
假设你非常强壮，并且拥有最强大的武器。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
If you don't know how to use the weapon's power, you will not be strong... You will be weak.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
如果你不知道如何发挥武器的威力，你就不会强大... 你只会变得弱小。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
When the tools or weapons
overwhelm your capabilities,
the worst situations result.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
当工具或武器超出了你的能力范围时，往往会导致最糟糕的结果。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmmm...
I'm in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯...
我遇到麻烦了...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I cannot do anything without my medicine. But one my patients
needs immediate treatment and
I can't leave the office...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
没有药我就什么都做不了。但我的一位病人需要立即治疗，而我不能离开诊所...

scripts.text: I can help you.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮你。

scripts.text: What a shame!
scripts.translation: 真遗憾！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Huh...?
Are...
Are you serious?
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
咦...？
你...
你是认真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
This won't take much effort, but it may be too much to ask this of you, especially since we have just met.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
这不需要费什么力气，但要求你这样做可能有点过分了，毕竟我们才刚刚认识。

scripts.text: If you feel burdened...
scripts.translation: 如果你觉得为难...

scripts.text: I don't mind, I'd be glad to help.
scripts.translation: 我不介意，我很乐意帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you so
much for saying that.
I feel very uncomfortable asking a favor of someone I have only just met.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
非常感谢你这么说。
向一个刚认识的人提出请求，让我感到很不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, I will ask you
if we meet another time.
Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
不过，如果我们下次再见面，我会向你提出请求的。
现在，请原谅我...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmm, I see.
Well then, let me
ask a favor of you.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯，我明白了。
那么，请让我向你提出一个请求。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
As you heard earlier, I need
a special medicine to treat this patient. However, I'm running out of the medicine I need.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
正如你刚才听到的，我需要一种特殊的药来治疗这位病人。然而，我需要的药快用完了。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I will need you to get it for me since I cannot leave the patients that are waiting for me right now.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
既然我现在不能离开正在等待我的病人，就需要你去帮我取药。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Misfortunes always seem
to occur one after another, don't they? My staff is currently too busy doing other errands.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
^666666*叹气*^000000
不幸的事情似乎总是接二连三地发生，不是吗？我的职员目前正忙着处理其他杂事。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Please visit the
Tool Shop in town and bring me
the medicine that I need. Master will understand if you tell him you've been sent by me.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
请去镇上的工具店，帮我取来我需要的药。如果你告诉店主你是我派来的，他会明白的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I am sorry for causing you
so much trouble, but if you'll excuse me, I have other patients waiting. Please hurry back with
the medicine!
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
很抱歉给你添了这么多麻烦，但请原谅我，还有其他病人在等着。请快点带着药回来！

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
^666666*Sigh*^000000 For some reason, I never seem to have enough medicine in stock. Is there no one I can ask to help me?
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
^666666*叹气*^000000 不知为何，我的药库存总是不够。难道就没有人能帮我一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
You haven't gotten
the medicine yet...?
I hope you can get it
as soon as you can...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
药还没取回来吗...？
希望你能尽快取回来...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
In order to prescribe medicine
and apply acupuncture suited to
a patient, I must first consider many different factors related to health.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
为了开出适合病人的药方并进行针灸治疗，我必须首先考虑许多与健康相关的因素。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I must be especially careful if the patient is in critical condition or is exhibiting unusual symptoms.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
如果病人情况危急或出现异常症状，我必须格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Umm.....
Is that so...?
I can understand if you
take your time to bring the item. There's no need to rush.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯.....
是吗...？
如果你需要时间慢慢去取，我也可以理解。不用着急。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Everybody has their own
worries, and I understand if your own problems must take priority.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
每个人都有自己的烦恼，我理解你可能需要优先处理自己的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good
to put yourself in someone
else's shoes sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
不过，偶尔站在别人的角度想一想也是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Umm.....
Is that so...?
I can understand if you
take your time in bringing what I need. There's no rush.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯.....
是吗...？
如果你需要时间慢慢把东西带回来，我也可以理解。不用着急。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Everybody has their own
worries, and I understand if your own problems must take priority.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
每个人都有自己的烦恼，我理解你可能需要优先处理自己的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good
to put yourself in someone
else's shoes sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
不过，偶尔站在别人的角度想一想也是好的。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah...
You've finally
brought it to me!
Thank you so much,
I feel much more relieved...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
啊...
你终于把它带回来了！
非常感谢，
我感觉轻松多了...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I apologize
in advance,
but may I ask
another favor of you?
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
先提前致歉，
但我能否再请你帮个忙？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I am asking you once more
as now I see that you are trustworthy. Of course, I will compensate you for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
我再次向你提出请求，是因为现在我看你值得信赖。当然，我会补偿你带来的麻烦。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I can't help you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我无法帮你。

scripts.text: No problem.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Alright....
I understand.
But let me thank you
for helping me out.
Please take this...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
好吧....
我明白了。
但还是要谢谢你帮了我的忙。
请收下这个...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
This medicine is not that
great, but it's an old family secret. I hope it will be useful to you if you find yourself in great danger.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
这个药虽然不算特别厉害，但却是家传秘方。我希望如果你身处险境时，它能对你有用。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Well then,
I will see
you around.
Once again, thank
you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
那么，
我们改天再见。
再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
I just ran out of some other medicines again, and I hope that you can assist me once more.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
谢谢你，
太感谢了！
我又缺了一些其他的药，希望你能再帮我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I hope that I am not causing
you too much trouble. Um, so the medicines I'll need are...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
希望我没有给你添太多麻烦。嗯，所以我需要的药是...

scripts.text:

^0000ff2 Leopard Claw^000000 which strengthen bones, ^0000ff10 Solid Peach^000000 which strengthens muscle, ^0000ff5 Poisonous Toad Skin^000000 which replenishes the skin...

[Hua Tuo]
I hope you were
able to memorize all
of that. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
希望你能记住所有这些。再说一遍，那是...

[Hua Tuo]
Being strong as a person is not defined as mere physical strength.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
一个人的强壮，并不仅仅定义为单纯的体力。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Factors such as intelligence, experience and knowledge are
also considered when judging one's strength.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
在判断一个人的强弱时，智力、经验和知识等因素也会被考虑在内。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Let's say you're very strong and given the most powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
假设你非常强壮，并且拥有最强大的武器。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
If you don't know how to use the weapon's power, you will not be strong... You will be weak.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
如果你不知道如何发挥武器的威力，你就不会强大... 你只会变得弱小。

the worst situations result.

Ah...
Did you just say you're going to gather all the items soon? Oh, thank you for your kindness.
I appreciate your effort
on my behalf.

啊...
你刚才说会尽快收集齐所有材料吗？
非常感谢你的好意。

I understand even
if you can't bring
the medicine right away.
scripts.translation:

嗯.....
是吗...？
如果你不能马上带来药材，
我也能理解的。

scripts.text:

It's okay for now,
so don't rush yourself.
Everybody has their own problems, so I can understand if your own troubles must take priority.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
现在这样也没关系，
不用太着急。
每个人都有各自的烦恼，
所以我理解你需要优先处理自己的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Still, it's good to see that you're understanding of the troubles other people are having.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
不过，很高兴看到你能体谅他人的难处。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Ah, finally...
You've brought what I need. Thank you so much, it's such a relief to have this medicine onhand again.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
啊，终于...
你带来了我所需要的东西。
非常感谢，
再次拥有这些药材让我松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
I apologize in advance,
but may I ask you another favor?
I am asking for your help once more, since I know I can depend on you. Of course, I will compensate you for your trouble.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
先提前致歉，
能再麻烦你一件事吗？
因为我知道可以信赖你，所以再次向你求助。
当然，我会补偿你的辛苦。

scripts.text: I'm sorry...
scripts.translation: 抱歉...

scripts.text: No problem.

scripts.text:

Alright....
I understand.
But thank you for
helping me out.
Please take this...
scripts.translation:

好的....
我理解。
但还是要谢谢你帮了我。
请收下这个...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[华佗]
虽然不多，但这药方是家传秘方。
希望它在危急时刻能对你有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Well then, I will see you around. Once again, I'd like to thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
那么，下次再见。
再次感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Thank you, thank you so much!
I've just run out of other medicines that my patients will be needing. I don't need too much, but you would be doing me a great favor.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
谢谢，非常感谢！
我的病人需要的其他药材刚好用完了。
不需要太多，但如果你能帮我这个忙，我将感激不尽。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
The medicines I need are ^0000ff2 Leopard Claw^000000 which supports the bones, ^0000ff10 Solid Peach^000000 which strengthens the muscle, ^0000ff5 Poisonous Toad Skin^000000 which replenishes the skin...
scripts.translation:

我需要的药材是^0000ff2花豹指甲^000000，用于强健骨骼；^0000ff10石榴桃^000000，用于增强肌肉；^0000ff5牛蛙之皮^000000，用于滋养皮肤...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯？啊，你回来了。
抱歉，我刚才在照顾其他病人。
你已经收集好我需要的药材了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Let's see...
Oh, you've brought them all.
Thank you so much for your
generous help. It's such a relief to have these medicines available again...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
让我看看...
哦，你都带来了。
非常感谢你的慷慨相助。
再次拥有这些药材让我松了一口气...

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Please take this as a token of my appreciation. It's not much, but this medicine is an old family secret. I hope it will be helpful to you in dangerous situations.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
请收下这个作为我的一点心意。
虽然不多，但这药方是家传秘方。
希望它在危急时刻能对你有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
However, please remember not to take more than the recommended dosage for the pills I have given you. Even medicine, in the wrong doses, can become poison to the body.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
不过，请记住不要超过我给你的药丸的建议剂量。
即使是药物，如果剂量不当，也会变成身体的毒药。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hmm...
Unfortunately, you haven't collected everything that I need yet. Once again, please gather...
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
嗯...
很遗憾，你还没有收集齐我需要的所有东西。
请再次收集...

[Hua Tuo]
Your health is affected by
many factors. Nutricious food and medicine alone cannot guarantee
a healthy lifestyle.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
你的健康受许多因素影响。
仅靠营养丰富的食物和药物，并不能保证健康的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Seemingly little things like your everyday mood and behavior, your thoughts and words also contribute to states of illness or well-being.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
日常的情绪和行为，以及你的想法和言语，看似微不足道，却也会影响身体的健康或疾病状态。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Everyone needs time to quiet
their thoughts and relax. If you can maintain a calm mood throughout your daily life, your body will greatly benefit.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
每个人都需要时间让思绪平静下来，放松身心。如果你能在日常生活中保持心情平和，你的身体将受益匪浅。

scripts.text:
[Hua Tuo]
Hahaha...
I hope you enjoy
your visit here
in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[华佗]
哈哈...
希望你在洛阳的访问愉快。

scripts.text:

Zzzzzzz
Zzzzz.....
Zzzzz.....

[Wang Chuiyi]
My business hasn't been doing
well recently. And what is wrong with this weather? I don't know what's going on with the world...
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
最近生意不太好。这天气到底怎么了？我不知道这个世界发生了什么...

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Darn it!
I hate this
weather...!
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
该死！
我讨厌这天气...！

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Um? Can I help
you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
嗯？有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I'm here to get something for the doctor...
scripts.translation: 我来给医生买些东西...

scripts.text: I agree, the weather really is bad.
scripts.translation: 是啊，天气真的很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Huh?
An errand for the doctor?
She must have run out of
medicine again. Go ahead
and check the storage.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
什么？
给医生跑腿？
她肯定是又没药了。去仓库看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
You can find the storage on
the opposite side of this building. There, you'll see a guy named Jiang Xiayou. Go ahead and ask him for the stuff you need.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
仓库在这栋建筑的对面。在那里，你会看到一个叫江夏游的家伙。去跟他要你需要的那些东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
Tell me about it. This weather keeps stressing me out. Damn,
I don't think I'll live very long if I keep getting aggravated like
this by the weather...
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
跟我说说吧。这天气让我很烦躁。该死，
如果我一直被这天气惹恼，我想我活不了多久了...

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
I can't understand why outsiders continue to travel here to Luoyang despite the weather. I'm also getting tired of keeping my business here. Sooner or later,
I may have to leave.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
我不明白为什么外面的人不顾天气还要来这里洛阳。我也受够了在这里做生意。迟早，
我可能会离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
What? He didn't give you the stuff you need? Huh, I guess you did something he didn't like. I can't help you if that's the case.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
什么？他没给你需要的东西？哼，看来你做了他不高兴的事。如果是这样，我帮不了你。

我可能会离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Wang Chuiyi]
God, what is wrong with this weather?! I wish the Cloud God would bring the rainy season, but it doesn't seem possible.
scripts.translation:
[王垂一]
天哪，这天气到底怎么了？！我希望云神能带来雨季，但这似乎不可能。

scripts.text:
[Jiang Xiayou]
^666666*Yawn...*^000000
This is boring...
So boring, it's ridiculous. I don't wanna waste any more time here, I've got important things to do...
scripts.translation:

^666666*哈欠...*^000000
真无聊...

scripts.text:

什么？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It's been 40 years since I came here. Hahaha, but it doesn't feel like it's been that long.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我来到这里已经40年了。
哈哈，但感觉并没有那么久。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
In the past, I was one of the
most renowned experts in the use
of poison. I even created a martial art based on its use, and formed my own martial arts organization.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
过去，我是最负盛名的毒术专家之一。
我甚至创立了一种基于毒术的武术，并建立了自己的武术组织。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Now, those memories
don't even seem real
anymore. This poem is
all I can remember...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
现在，那些记忆
甚至都不像真的了。
这首诗
是我唯一能记住的...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I lay in bed looking
up at the moonlight
 
It looks like the
frost on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
当我躺在床上
仰望月光
 
它看起来像
地上的霜。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I lift head up to look
at the bright moon,
 
I lower my head
feeling homesick.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我抬起头
看着明亮的月亮，
 
我低下头
感到思乡。

scripts.text: Ask about the poem.
scripts.translation: 询问关于这首诗

scripts.text: Ask about his hometown.
scripts.translation: 询问关于他的家乡

scripts.text: Ask about use of Poison.
scripts.translation: 询问关于毒术的使用

scripts.text: Ask about his situation.
scripts.translation: 询问关于他的情况

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Ah, have you
heard of this poem?
As I grow older, my
memory also grows worse,
but I really like this poem
and don't want to forget it.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
啊，你听说过
这首诗吗？
随着我变老，
我的记忆力也变差了，
但我真的很喜欢这首诗，
不想忘记它。

scripts.text:

mind helping me
memorize this poem...

我希望你不介意
帮我记住这首诗...

[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]

[Nagash Arses]
I tried many things to develop my poison skills when I was young.
I tried to extract poison from Muka's needles and from purple mushrooms. Eventually, I became
an expert of toxins from my efforts.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
年轻时，我尝试了许多方法来提升我的毒术。
我尝试从摩卡的毒针和紫色蘑菇中提取毒素。最终，凭借这些努力，我成为了毒素专家。

scripts.text:

a poison into my own body
to fully test it. Yeah...
It almost killed me.
scripts.translation:

那差点要了我的命。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was recognized as the man who
was most highly skilled in the use of poison in the 'Canine of Desert,' and I was sent on the most crucial and dangerous missions.
scripts.translation:

我被公认为“沙漠之犬”中精通毒术的人，并被派去执行最关键、最危险的任务。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
One day, I was hired by the Alberta Merchant Guild to assassinate an enemy that had been threatening them. However, I never got to complete that mission.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
有一天，艾尔贝塔商人公会雇佣我去刺杀一个威胁他们的敌人。然而，我没能完成那个任务。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]

scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
在前往执行任务的船上，我们遭遇了狂风巨浪，船沉了。我相信我是那场事故中唯一的幸存者。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]

to arrive here, in Luoyang. That was forty years ago.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我无助地漂浮在大海上，不知怎的竟然漂流到了这里，洛阳。那是四十年前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It seemed that my arrival was rather timely. Luoyang was intruded by huge mobs of dangerous monsters that were even able to infiltrate the Castle of the Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我的到来似乎恰逢其时。洛阳被大量危险的魔物入侵，它们甚至渗透到了龙城堡。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Since I was one of the best Assassins of the 'Canine of Desert,' I did far more than my share of monster killing.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
既然我是“沙漠之犬”中顶尖的刺客之一，我杀死的魔物远超我的份内之事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It was on the battlefield that
I met Bai Long who is now lord of this town. But back then, he was known as the 'Street Knight.'
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
正是在战场上，我遇到了现在的城镇领主白龙。不过那时候，他被称为“街头骑士”。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I remember seeing him surrounded
by enemies, and I dove into thick of battle to keep him from getting killed. We fought back to back and managed to stay alive back then.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我记得看到他被敌人包围，我冲入战场中心，防止他被杀死。我们背靠背作战，在那时幸存了下来。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You have to understand that it's not easy to let someone back you
up in battle unless there's a solid trust. Those fights... were the greatest moments in my life.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你要明白，除非有坚定的信任，否则在战斗中让人掩护你的后背并不容易。那些战斗...是我生命中最伟大的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Sadly, many of our comrades,
all of them respectable and highly skilled martial artists, fell in battle. The number of monsters we had to contend with was just overwhelming.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
遗憾的是，我们的许多同志，都是受人尊敬且技艺高超的武术家，在战斗中牺牲了。我们要对抗的魔物数量实在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Still, I managed to continue my poison research, even during those tough times. I studied medicine in this town and was able use that knowledge to enhance my understanding of poisons.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
尽管如此，即使在那些艰难时期，我仍坚持进行毒物研究。我在这个城镇学习医学，并利用那些知识加深了对毒素的理解。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I created a new skill based on all of my knowledge, and learned how
to put poison on weapons.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我基于所有知识创造了一项新技能，并学会了如何在武器上涂抹毒素。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I even learned martial arts in Luoyang, and combined that
knowledge with my poison expertise to create my own unique fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我甚至在洛阳学习了武术，并将这些知识与我的毒术专长结合，创造出了自己独特的战斗风格。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Well, that's my story.
But now, I just miss my
home town. I miss the heat
of the desert and the glare
of the blazing sun...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
好了，这就是我的故事。
但现在，我只是想念我的家乡。我怀念沙漠的热量和燃烧的太阳的刺眼光芒...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Ah, Morocc.
That name brings
back memories of
being an Assassin
in the 'Canine of Desert.'
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
啊，摩洛哥。
这个名字让我想起了
作为“沙漠之犬”刺客的日子。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
I wish I could see
Morocc just once before I die.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
^666666*叹息*^000000
在死之前，
我真希望能再见摩洛哥一面。

scripts.text: Tell him news of Morocc.
scripts.translation: 告诉他莫洛克的近况。

scripts.text: Ask about 'Canine of Desert.'
scripts.translation: 询问关于“沙漠之犬”的事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Hm...?
Is there anything
you want to say?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
嗯...？
你有什么
想说的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have news
of Morocc...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有关于
摩洛哥的消息...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I see...
Thank you for
telling me that.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
原来如此...
谢谢你告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I see!
You just said, {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
原来如此！
你刚才说了，{0}。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I just told you what 'Canine of Desert.' If you can't remember what I just told you, it's no use for me to explain further. You go ahead and tell me what it is.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我刚才已经告诉过你“沙漠之犬”是什么了。如果你不记得我刚才说的话，我再解释也没用。你自己说说看那是什么。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Correct. You listened to me very well. They are Assassins. Assassins that were abandoned by society.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
正确。你听得很仔细。他们是刺客。是被社会遗弃的刺客。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Canine of Desert
is the name of an
Assassin organization.
Do not forget that.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
“沙漠之犬”
是一个刺客组织的名字。
别忘了这一点。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
How could you not know what the 'Canine of Desert' is?! Just how long have you been an Assassin?!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你怎么会不知道“沙漠之犬”是什么呢？！你当刺客多久了？！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're supposed to be aware of your origins and your colleagues! Oh, the shame...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你应该清楚自己的出身和同伴啊！真是丢人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Well, I suppose I can't blame you for not knowing or remembering. When you get the chance, find someone wearing a purple suit...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
嗯，我想你不知情或忘记也不足为奇。如果有机会的话，去找找穿紫色西装的人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Any Assassin worth his salt should know what the 'Canine of Desert' is.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
任何合格的刺客都应该知道“沙漠之犬”是什么。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you just say you
want to learn about the
use of poison?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你刚才说
想学习毒物的用法？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why do you want
to learn about it?
Even if I wanted to
teach, I'm too old to
remember everything
clearly...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你为什么想学这个？
就算我想教，
我也太老了，
记不清所有细节了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Go find my last disciple,
^0000FFSong Zhi Du^000000, as he may tell you something useful. He's working at the doctor's office. If it weren't for him, I'd be starving now.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
去找我最后的弟子，
^0000FF宋志度^000000，他可能会告诉你一些有用的事。他在诊所工作。要不是有他，我现在早就饿死了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you just say you
want to learn about the
use of poison?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你刚才说
想学习毒物的用法？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why do you want
to learn about it?
Even if I wanted to
teach, I'm too old to
remember everything
clearly...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你为什么想学这个？
就算我想教，
我也太老了，
记不清所有细节了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're asking me how
things came to be like
this? Life used to be good.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你问我事情是怎么变成这样的？
以前生活挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I told you, I distinguished myself in the battles with monsters. I was rewarded with Luoyang citizenship and given
gifts of money.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
正如我所说，我在与魔物的战斗中表现突出。我因此获得了洛阳的公民身份，并收到了金钱赏赐。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was invited to join a martial arts organization that specialized in the use of poison. I joined them, excited about further broadening my knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我被邀请加入一个专门研究毒物使用的武术组织。我兴奋地加入了他们，希望能进一步拓宽我的知识。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I was stunned by the enormous body of knowledge about toxins that they provided. I tried to learn as much as I could so I could develop my own, unique poisoning skills.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
他们提供的关于毒素的庞大知识让我震惊。我试图尽可能多地学习，以便开发出我自己独特的毒术技能。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I studied with them, together we started to clear the town of the remaining monsters. Can you guess the results of our efforts to clean up the city?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
在他们那里学习期间，我们一起开始清理城镇中剩余的魔物。你能猜到我们清理城市的成果吗？

scripts.text: It must have been good.
scripts.translation: 那一定很好吧。

scripts.text: I guess it was okay?
scripts.translation: 我想应该还行？

scripts.text: I don't know, but how did it go?
scripts.translation: 我不知道，但结果如何？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did you even listen to me? It's no use talking to you if you don't even care about what I have to say.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你根本没在听我说话吧？如果你根本不在乎我说的话，那跟你谈也没用。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm sorry for keeping you from what you wanted to do. Take care of yourself, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
抱歉耽误了你原本想做的事。保重身体，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You're right!
We got rid of every
single monster in the city!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你说得对！
我们把城里所有的魔物都清理干净了！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Just okay...?
I don't think you realized how powerful we were back then! Eh...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
只是“还行”吗？
我想你并没有意识到我们当时有多强大。呃...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Sorry for keeping you from what you wanted to do. Take care of yourself, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
抱歉耽误了你原本想做的事。保重身体，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
We got rid of every single monster in the city!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我们把城里所有的魔物都清理干净了！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
We managed to eliminate every monster that was wandering around Luoyang. At the time, we were the only people brave enough to take on this sort of task.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我们消灭了所有在洛阳游荡的魔物。当时，只有我们有勇气承担这样的任务。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Unfortunately, other martial arts organizations grew envious of our success, insisting that we were dishonorable for using poison to attack our enemies.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
不幸的是，其他武术组织嫉妒我们的成功，指责我们使用毒药攻击敌人是不光彩的行为。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Although we can accept criticism for our use of poison, we were finally blamed for something we never would have done.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
虽然我们可以接受对使用毒药的批评，但最终我们却被指责做了我们绝不会做的事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Someone put poison into a meal which was eaten by a son of the lord and then falsely accused us!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
有人在食物里下了毒，被领主之子吃下后，他们竟然诬陷是我们干的！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
In the end, our organization was disbanded and I was put in jail.
I suffered through much to escape from prison...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
最后，我们的组织被解散，我也被投入了监狱。
为了越狱，我受尽了折磨...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
However, because of all the injuries I've had to endure in jail and in my escape attempts,
I can no longer use my
martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
然而，由于在监狱和越狱尝试中遭受的种种伤痛，
我已经无法再使用
武术了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Even to this day, the police are hounding after me. I really want to tell the lord of Luoyang that I'm innocent, but it may be
too late now...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
直到今天，警察仍在追捕我。我真的很想向洛阳的领主证明我的清白，但现在可能已经太晚了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I...
I don't want
to talk about that.
Let's not talk about it.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我...
我不想谈那些。
我们别谈这个了。

scripts.text: Grin at him.
scripts.translation: 对他咧嘴一笑

scripts.text: Lament for his grief.
scripts.translation: 为他的悲伤感到惋惜

scripts.text: Reprove him.
scripts.translation: 责备他

scripts.text: Listen to the poem again.
scripts.translation: 再听一遍那首诗

scripts.text: Show him a sad look.
scripts.translation: 露出悲伤的表情

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Yeah, I don't blame you.
I know I look stupid. Legally,
I'm a criminal after all.
I don't any friends and
there's no one I can trust.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
是啊，我不怪你。
我知道自己看起来很蠢。在法律上，
我毕竟是个罪犯。
我没有朋友，
也没有可以信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
How can you sympathize?
I doubt anyone has had
experiences that are
much worse than mine...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你怎能同情我？
我怀疑很少有人
经历过比我更糟糕的
事情...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Wha--? I haven't wronged you in any way! Why must you be so mean to an old man? You don't even know half of what I've had to go through.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
什...？我并没有得罪你！
为什么你要对一个老人这么刻薄？
你根本不知道我经历过什么。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
As I lay in bed looking
up at the moonlight
 
It looks like the
frost on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
当我躺在床上
仰望月光
 
它看起来像
地上的霜。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I lift head up to look
at the bright moon,
 
I lower my head
feeling homesick.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我抬起头
看着明亮的月亮，
 
我低下头
感到思乡。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Do you miss your hometown
as much as I do? I'm envious
of you, youngster. You have
the freedom to go
wherever you want.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你和我一样思念家乡吗？
年轻人，我很羡慕你。
你拥有自由，
想去哪里就去哪里。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm a wanted criminal.
Even if I were free to
travel, I may not have
the strength to try.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我是个通缉犯。
即使我有自由，
我可能也没有
尝试的力气了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Let's not talk about this any longer. It's reminding me of
my worst memories.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
别再谈这个了。
这让我想起了
最痛苦的回忆。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Ah, you look just like I did when
I was young. It seems you know
a little something about poison.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
啊，你看起来
像我年轻时的样子。
看来你对毒药
略知一二。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
It seems you haven't
perfected your knowledge yet,
though. Oh well, I doubt I can
pinpoint what you need to master.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
不过，看来你还没有
完全掌握相关知识。
算了，我也很难
指出你需要精通什么。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm too old to remember anything. Ha ha ha. Maybe if I saw something related to poison, I might remember something...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我年纪太大了，记不起任何事。
哈哈。也许如果看到
与毒药有关的东西，
我可能会想起些什么...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
No, no...
I think I'm too old
to remember anything.
Anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
不，不...
我想我年纪太大了，
记不起任何事。
任何事都记不起来了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I'm too old to remember anything. Ha ha ha. Maybe if I saw something related to poison, I might remember something...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我年纪太大了，记不起任何事。
哈哈。也许如果看到
与毒药有关的东西，
我可能会想起些什么...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
No, no...
I think I'm too old
to remember anything.
Anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
不，不...
我想我年纪太大了，
记不起任何事。
任何事都记不起来了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
If you wish to talk about poison, you'd better go to the doctor's office. My last disciple is
working there.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
如果你想谈论毒药，
最好去诊所。
我最后的弟子
在那里工作。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Now, let me rest.
I am very tired.
I... I hope he doesn't
have any bad intentions...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
好了，让我休息一下吧。
我很累。
我...我希望他
没有恶意...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Aren't you the youngster
I talked to a while ago?
Did you get a chance
to meet my disciple?
How was he?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你难道不是
刚才和我说话的那个年轻人吗？
你有机会见到我的弟子吗？
他怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
He was sick all the time when he was young, so he worried me a lot. But now I'm proud of him and he's doing as well just any other fine young man.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
他小时候总是生病，
让我很担心。但现在我为他感到骄傲，
他和其他优秀的年轻人一样
做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I am living only for him,
and hope that he becomes a great healer someday. Recently, I've found that my sole comfort is in treating diseases for other people...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我活着只是为了他，
希望他将来能成为一位伟大的医生。
最近，我发现我唯一的慰藉
就是为别人治病...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
By the way...
You look pale...
Did something happen?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
顺便问一下...
你脸色苍白...
发生什么事了吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text: I want to talk about your diciple.
scripts.translation: 我想谈谈你的弟子。

scripts.text: I don't feel good.
scripts.translation: 我感觉不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Oh...
I see...
But take care
of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
哦...
我明白了...
但请照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You better enjoy your physical strength when you're young. When you're my age, it's tough to regain your health once you lose it.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
趁年轻好好享受你的体力吧。
到了我这个年纪，
一旦失去健康，就很难恢复了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Did something happen to him?
I've been worried since he hasn't come to visit me since you last came to speak with me.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
他出什么事了吗？
自从你上次来和我说话后，
他就没来探望我，
我一直很担心。

scripts.text: Give him Poison Bottle.
scripts.translation: 给他毒药瓶

scripts.text: Cancel and go to 'Song Zhi Du.
scripts.translation: 取消并去找宋志度

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Huh!?
Isn't this...!?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
什么！？
这不是...！？

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I've dreamed of creating
a poison of such potency!
W-where did you find this?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我一直梦想着能创造出如此强力的毒药！
你...你是在哪里找到这个的？

scripts.text: It's common nowadays.
scripts.translation: 现在很常见

scripts.text: Explain to him what happened.
scripts.translation: 向他解释发生了什么

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Really...?
Then someone
finally figured it out.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
真的吗...？
看来终于有人
研究出来了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I shared all of my knowledge with others, so I guess a doctor might have figured how to create this.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我把所有的知识都传授给了别人，
我想大概是某位医生
研究出了制造这种毒药的方法吧。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Now I feel depressed
for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
^666666*叹息...*^000000
不知道为什么，
我现在感觉很沮丧...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Nagash Arses how
Song Zhi Du created this Deadly Poison Bottle and his plan to get his revenge on the lord of Luoyang.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF告诉纳加什·阿尔塞斯，
宋志度是如何制造出这瓶致命猛毒的，
以及他向洛阳领主复仇的计划。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000

[Nagash Arses]
Will you...
Will you excuse
me for a second...?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
请...请允许我
失礼片刻...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Nothing much.

[Nagash Arses]
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
嗯...？
看来你并不清楚发生了什么。
我听到了一些关于他的坏消息，
所以才这么问。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
希望他没事。
毕竟，他心地
真的很善良。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Hmm...?
I guess you don't know what is going on. I've heard some bad rumors about him, which is why I'm asking.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
嗯...？
看来你并不清楚发生了什么。
我听到了一些关于他的坏消息，
所以才这么问。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope he'll be fine.
After all, he's truly
kind at heart.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
希望他没事。
毕竟，他心地
真的很善良。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Oh, you don't?
Well, that can happen
sometimes when you're
in a foreign land for
too long. I hope you
feel better soon.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
哦，是吗？
有时候在异国他乡待太久
也会发生这种事。
希望你快点好起来。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Recently...
I've been getting
a bad feeling...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
最近...
我总有一种
不好的预感...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I want to blame it
on my solitude, but...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我想把这归咎于
我的孤独，但是...

scripts.text: ^3355FFNagash Arses. He is no longer a well-known Assassin or the martial arts organization of which he was once master has long since disbanded.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF纳加什·阿尔塞斯。他不再是那位著名的刺客，
他曾经统领的武术组织也早已解散。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow he is but a poor old man
who is in anguish over his disciple. No matter what you say, he continues to talk about something totally unrelated, as if in a dream.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF如今他只是一个为弟子痛苦不堪的可怜老人。
无论你说什么，他都像是在梦中一样，
不停地谈论着完全不相干的事情。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Youngster...
I beg of you.
Please do not let him
bring any harm to the lord.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
年轻人...
求求你了。
请千万不要让他
伤害到白龙大人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
If you cannot stop him,
then please interrupt him
from carrying out his plan.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
如果你无法阻止他，
那就请打断他
实施计划的行动。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I tried...
To convince myself
that what I had heard
were just ugly rumors.
I was wrong...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我曾试图...
说服自己
听到的那些
只是恶意的谣言。
但我错了...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I am pretty sure he's been asking you, as well as others, for aid. Even if you do not agree to carry out his plan, I'm sure he will find someone to poison Lord Bai Long.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我很确定他也在向你，
以及其他的人求助。
即使你不同意执行他的计划，
我相信他也会找到别人
去毒害白龙大人。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
There is only one way he can poison
the lord. He likes drinking, and has a favorite drink bottle he keeps with him all the time. You must get rid of his drink.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
他毒害大人的方法只有一种。
他喜欢喝酒，而且总是随身携带
一个他最喜欢的酒壶。你必须毁掉他的酒。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Please, I beg you.
For my sake, as well
as that of my disciple,
Luoyang's leader must live...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
求求你了。
为了我，也为了我的弟子，
洛阳的首领必须活下去...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
So...
What...
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
那么...
发生了...
什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I made it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做到了。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
You did?!
Oh~ thank you,
thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
你做到了？！
噢~ 谢谢你，
真的非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Thank God I've
lived this long.
And... I just realized
something while you away.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
感谢上天让我
活到了现在。
而且... 趁你不在的时候，
我突然意识到了一件事。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
This is a journal that I have been writing for 15 years about my feelings of guilt, and what really happened in the past. I hope you can deliver this to the lord for me.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
这是我写了15年的日记，
记录了我内心的愧疚，
以及过去真正发生的事。
希望你能把它交给白龙大人。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou obtained
^0000FFPoison King
Nagash Arses' Journal^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你获得了
^0000FF纳加什·阿尔塞斯的日记^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
I hope you
can deliver this
to Lord Bai Long...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
希望你能把它
交给白龙大人...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou gave him the
^0000FFLetter from Bai Long^000000.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你给了他
^0000FF白龙大人的信件^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
What's this...?
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
这是什么...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Why, he's invited me
to take the position of
a government official!
I'm truly grateful!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
原来，他邀请我
担任政府官员！
我真的非常感激！

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
However, please let him
know that I must respectfully decline his offer. I'm afraid that I may be a burden to him once again.
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
不过，请让他知道，
我必须恭敬地拒绝他的好意。
我怕自己再次成为他的负担。

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Please tell him that I wish to enjoy the rest of my life here. Also, there are people here
who still need me...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
请告诉他，我希望在这里
度过余生。而且，这里还有
需要我照顾的人...

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
Thank you, youngster.
You've stopped my disciple
and helped me make up
with an old friend...
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
谢谢你，年轻人。
你阻止了我的弟子，
还帮我与一位老友
重归于好...

scripts.text: ^3355FFNagash Arses put his palm on your back, and you can feel his strength flowing into you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF纳加什·阿尔塞斯将手掌放在你的背上，你能感觉到他的力量流入你的身体。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou grow dizzy, but you also feel like you're becoming more powerful and gaining experience.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你感到一阵眩晕，但同时也觉得自己变得更强了，并获得了经验值。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThen...
Everything blacks out...^000000

^3355FFHe looks tired
for some reason,
as if he's thinking
of Morocc, his hometown.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不知为何，他看起来很疲惫，
仿佛正在思念他的故乡莫洛克。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou reflect on when he gave you his remaining strength and remember that he told you that he used to be one of the greatest Assassins...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你回想起他将剩余的力量传授给你的那一刻，
记得他曾告诉你，他曾是伟大的刺客之一...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBut after all that's happened,
he just looks like an old man who likes treating other people. It seems that he's finally at peace with himself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF但经历了一切之后，
他看起来只是一个喜欢照顾他人的老人。似乎他终于与自己和解了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nagash Arses]
My name, Nagash Arses,
is also the name of the poison king in the legend of Arcturus. I have good reason to be proud of my name!
scripts.translation:
[纳加什·阿尔塞斯]
我的名字，纳加什·阿尔塞斯，
也是阿尔克图斯传说中“毒王”的名字。我有充分的理由为这个名字感到自豪！

scripts.text:
^3355FF * Wait a minute! *
You're carrying too many items with you right now. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等等！ *
你现在携带的物品太多了。请将一些物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后再试一次。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Let's see, there's that medicine, and then the medicine over here...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
让我看看，这里有那种药，还有那边的药...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
...
......

[Song Zhi Du]
I feel like you're looking at me. Is there something that you want?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我感觉你在看着我。有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Ask him about his master.
scripts.translation: 询问他的师父

scripts.text: Ask about Poison Organization.
scripts.translation: 询问毒组织

scripts.text: Ask why he's working here.
scripts.translation: 询问他为何在此工作

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I guess there's nothing you really need from me. Well then, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
看来你并没有特别需要我的地方。那么，失陪了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm kind of busy right now. You see, we're running out of medicine...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦，抱歉，我现在有点忙。你看，我们的药快用完了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
My master, Hua Tuo,
is also having difficulty treating all of his patients. I must get him the medicine that he needs...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我的师父华佗，
也很难应付所有的病人。我必须去给他取需要的药...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
What...?
What did
you just say...?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
什么...？
你刚才说什么...？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
{0}...?

[Song Zhi Du]
I've never heard of that organization in my life. I'm sorry I can't help you. Now, if you'll excuse me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我从未听说过那个组织。抱歉帮不了你。那么，失陪了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Of course I'm working here to learn about medicine. I'm grateful for the chance to work under the most famous doctor in this area.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我当然是在这里学习医术。我很感激能有机会在这位当地最著名的医生手下工作。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Doctor Hua Tuo is such a great person. I'm more than happy to assist him in saving the lives of others with his medical knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
华佗医生真是位了不起的人。能协助他用医术拯救他人的生命，我感到非常荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Even though I'm just in charge of the medicine storage, I'm working hard to become his disciple someday.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
虽然我目前只负责管理药材仓库，但我一直在努力，希望能有朝一日成为他的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
And working with Doctor Hua Tuo is really worthwhile. Well, sometimes it's really hard to supply medicine when we have too many patients though.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
和华佗医生一起工作真的很有价值。不过，有时候病人太多，供应药材确实很吃力。

scripts.text: Why don't you gather medicinal herbs then?
scripts.translation: 那你去采集草药吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
My job is keeping this storage.
I'm not supposed to leave my position. I need to organize the herbs, and make sure they're in good condition.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我的工作是看守这个仓库。
我不应该擅离职守。我需要整理草药，并确保它们状态良好。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Well, well. Thank you for your trouble. I didn't expect you to gather all these herbs for us...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哎呀，真是麻烦你了。没想到你会为我们采集这么多草药...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose I underestimated you. By the way, do you know anything about poison?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
看来是我小看你了。顺便问一下，你了解毒药吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am kind of interested in it.
scripts.translation: 是的，我对此颇感兴趣。

scripts.text: No, not at all.
scripts.translation: 不，完全不了解。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, I see. Well, if you have some time, why don't you go visit my old master in the slums?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦，我明白了。如果你有空的话，不妨去贫民窟拜访一下我的旧日师父？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If you two get along, I will tell you something important.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果你们相处融洽，我会告诉你一些重要的事情。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Huh. I see. Well, thank you for your trouble once again. I hope you have a good time in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯，我明白了。再次感谢你的辛苦付出。祝你在洛阳玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
...
So, did you talk
to my old master?
It seems he really
likes you.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
...
那么，你和我的旧日师父谈过了吗？
看来他真的很喜欢你。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
As you know, my master has been accused of something he didn't do! And they crippled his use of the martial arts!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你也知道，我的师父被诬陷做了他没做过的事！而且他们废掉了他的武功！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I can't forgive what
they've have done to my master!
I want to grind their bones
to powder! And that's before
I kill them!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我无法原谅他们对我师父所做的一切！
我要把他们的骨头磨成粉！
在那之前，我要先杀了他们！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
He's innocent and all he did
was research poison with all
of his effort! And for that,
they destroyed him!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
他是无辜的，他只是一心一意地研究毒药！
就因为这个，他们毁了他！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I was young
when it happened...
Too young to know
any martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
事情发生的时候我还很小...
太小了，还不懂什么武功。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I couldn't protect him.
All I could do was hide and
watch other people get killed.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我没能保护他。
我只能躲藏起来，看着其他人被杀害。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I hate myself
for not being strong!
But, my body isn't suited
for martial arts.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我恨自己不够强大！
但我的身体并不适合习武。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
All I can do is maintain my weak body and make sure it's reasonably healthy. Even so, if it weren't for my master, I'd be dead
in the streets...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我能做的只是维持我虚弱的身体，确保它还算健康。即便如此，如果不是我的师父，我早就死在街头了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
It was my master who picked me up from the streets and cured me. So, I've decided to become a doctor and save as many lives as I can.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
是师父把我从街头捡回来，治好了我的病。所以，我决定成为一名医生，拯救尽可能多的生命。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But before
I do that,
I want ^FF0000revenge^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但在那之前，
我要^FF0000复仇^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
As I told you, I am weak.
Too weak... I know that from
the bottom of my heart.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
正如我告诉你的，我很虚弱。
太虚弱了...我从心底里知道这一点。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I am knowledgable about medicine, especially the use of poison. I can tell you that I'm one of the best.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我对医学很有研究，尤其是毒药的使用。我可以告诉你，我是最擅长的人之一。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Poison can kill people but it can also be used to save lifes. The people who destroyed my master
will pay the price.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
毒药可以杀人，也可以救人。那些毁了我师父的人，必将付出代价。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Do you understand
why I'm furious!?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你明白我为什么
如此愤怒吗！?

scripts.text: But revenge isn't good.
scripts.translation: 复仇是不对的。

scripts.text: Yes, I fully understand.
scripts.translation: 是的，我完全理解。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hmm...
I see.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯...
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose you couldn't
understand the way I feel.
After all, you didn't have
to go through the same
things I did.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我想你无法理解我的感受。
毕竟，你没有经历过
和我一样的事情。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I suppose I expected too much, since my master likes you. How could you know the rage and
sadness that I feel!?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我想是我期望太高了，毕竟师父喜欢你。你怎么可能知道我所感受到的
愤怒和悲伤！?

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Fine.
Go do whatever
you were going to do.
I'm just disappointed...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
算了。
去做你该做的事吧。
我只是很失望...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Yes! Yes!
You do understand!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
是的！是的！
你确实理解！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I volunteered for this medicine storage position so that I can secretly study poison! Now, the time for action has come!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我自愿申请这个药品仓库的职位，就是为了能偷偷研究毒药！现在，行动的时刻到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Still, I'll need some materials to complete my research. Then, when
I succeed and create a poison pill, I'll need someone to carry my revenge out for me.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不过，我还需要一些材料来完成我的研究。然后，当我成功制出毒药丸，我需要有人替我执行复仇。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Since my body is so frail, I can't bear the tension and rage of seeing my lifelong enemy face to face.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
由于我身体虚弱，我无法承受与毕生仇敌面对面时的紧张和愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I'm so disappointed.
You've even seen the
pitiable state of my
master for yourself!
How could you not
understand me?!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我太失望了。
你甚至亲眼见过
我师父那可怜的样子！
你怎么可能不理解我？!

scripts.text: I'm sorry for last time.
scripts.translation: 上次的事我很抱歉。

scripts.text: No matter what, revenge isn't good.
scripts.translation: 无论如何，复仇是不对的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If you really
feel sorry for me,
then you must help me
carry out my revenge!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果你真的
为我感到难过，
那就必须帮我
实现复仇！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I still need to complete the
poison potion I'm creating. I hope you can bring what I need to finish it. Go and get me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我还需要完成
我正在研制的毒药。
希望你能帮我
找来所需的材料。去给我弄点...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
^0000FF4 10 只蜜蜂，
10 只毒犬，
10 个空瓶子，
30 瓶绿色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
An apology is fine, but you must also show me that you are sorry and help me carry out my plan. Do you have any problem with this?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
道歉是可以的，
但你必须向我证明
你的诚意，并帮我
实现计划。你有意见吗？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh, forget about it.
I don't think I can ever
make you understand how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
算了，随你吧。
我觉得我永远
无法让你理解
我的感受。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
So, did you
gather everything
I asked of you?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
那么，你
都把我需要的
东西集齐了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: What do you need again?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah...
With these, I accept your apology. Thank you for all the trouble you went through to get this stuff.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊...
有了这些，我接受你的道歉。
谢谢你费心去
收集这些东西。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now that you're this involved, you're in this with me all the way! I've been waiting for this
day for years...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
既然你已经
卷入其中，那就
跟我一起到底吧！
我等待这一天
已经好多年了...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
All that's left is to create this poison, and then to get the
lord of Luoyang to drink it...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
剩下的就是
制造这种毒药，
然后让洛阳的
领主喝下去...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Where are things
I asked you to bring?
Are you testing my
patience or what?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我让你带的
东西在哪里？
你是在考验
我的耐心吗？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
You're still missing some of the items I need. I must have them all in order to finish making this poison!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你还缺一些
我需要的材料。
我必须集齐所有
材料才能完成毒药！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Sigh...*
Go and get me...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*叹气...*
去给我弄点...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting,
10 Venom Canine,
10 Empty Potion,
30 Green Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
^0000FF4 10 只蜜蜂，
10 只毒犬，
10 个空瓶子，
30 瓶绿色药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，你好。
请给我一分钟，
我刚收到一条
消息。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
上面说我的
包裹终于
送到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你能帮我去
洛阳入口处的
爆竹小姐那里
拿个箱子吗？
先谢过了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah. Thank you,
I needed this. Now,
shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，谢谢，
我正需要这个。
那么，我们
开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
首先，我将把
从毒犬身上提取的
毒液，与一种名为
卡勒波迪药水的外来液体混合。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then, I add Green Herb extract, poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy into the liquid! Finally, I must heat them all!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然后，我加入
绿色药草提取物、
从蜜蜂身上提取的
毒液以及巨大杰勒比结晶！
最后，我必须加热它们！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
最后，我必须
小心地加热混合物，
并将其收集到
药水瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I've got to do this just right. This is a very delicate procedure...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
现在，我必须一次成功。这是一个非常精细的过程...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
No!! I failed again! ^666666*Sigh...*^000000 And I spent a long time preparing all of those materials...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不！！我又失败了！^666666*叹气*^000000 我花了很长时间准备这些材料...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, hello.
Please give me a minute,
I've just received a message.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，你好。
请给我一分钟，
我刚收到一条
消息。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
It says here
that my delivery
has finally arrived!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
上面说我的
包裹终于
送到了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Would you bring me the
box from the firecracker
lady at the entrance
to Luoyang? Thanks
in advance.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你能帮我去
洛阳入口处的
爆竹小姐那里
拿个箱子吗？
先谢过了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Oh! You brought
me everything I need!
I'm very impressed!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哦！你把我需要的东西都带来了！
真让我刮目相看！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
You're the only one
who actually understands how
I feel. Thank you for gathering all of these ^FF0000materials^000000.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
你是唯一真正理解我感受的人。
谢谢你收集了所有这些^FF0000材料^000000。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Alright, now
to create the poison.
This is going to be tough.
Here we go...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
好了，现在开始制作毒药。
这会很难。
开始吧...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
First, I shall mix a poison extracted from Venom Canine
with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
首先，我将把
从毒犬身上提取的
毒液，与一种名为
卡勒波迪药水的外来液体混合。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then, I add Green Herb extract,
a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然后，我加入绿色药草提取物、
从史汀身上提取的毒液
以及巨大杰勒比结晶！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Finally, I have to carefully heat the mixture and collect it all into a Potion Bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
最后，我必须
小心地加热混合物，
并将其收集到
药水瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*呼...*
成...成功了吗？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha~!
Success! 
It works!
I finally created it!
Mwahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈~！
成功了！
有效！
我终于做出来了！
哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
呜哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahaha!
Hahahahahahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
呜哈哈哈！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I made it!
I made it!
Now, revenge will be mine!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
做出来了！
做出来了！
现在，复仇将属于我！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha! Now, please
take this bottle. But be careful. Even if you smell it just a little, it can cause your body to decompose, leading to death.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈！请收下这个瓶子。
但请小心。即使只是闻到一点，
也会导致身体分解，进而死亡。

[Song Zhi Du]

with a foreign liquid named Karvodailnirol.
scripts.translation:

首先，我将把

毒液，与一种名为
卡勒波迪药水的外来液体混合。

Then I add Green Herb extract, a poison extracted from Bee Sting and a Large Jellopy!
scripts.translation:

然后，我加入绿色药草提取物、

以及巨大杰勒比结晶！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Then I must carefully heat the mixture, and gather it all into a potion bottle.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
然后，我必须小心地加热混合物，
并将其收集到空药瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
*Phew...*
Did...
Did I make it?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
*呼...*
成...成功了吗？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
NO! I... I've failed again! And I spent a long time getting everything ready...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不！我...我又失败了！
我花了很长时间准备所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I'm not sure what went wrong.
Hmm, would you please help me again? I've used all the materials from last time.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我不确定哪里出了问题。
嗯，你能再帮我一次吗？
上次的材料都用完了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
^0000FF4 Bee Sting^000000,
^0000FF10 Venom Canine^000000,
^0000FF10 Empty Potion Bottle^000000,
^0000FF30 Green Potion^000000 and
^0000FF1 Large Jellopy^000000.

[Song Zhi Du]
That's everything I'll need.
I would apologize, but since you've shown that you'll help carry out my revenge, I know you'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
这就是我需要的所有东西。
我想道歉，但既然你愿意帮助我实施复仇，
我知道你会理解的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahahaha...!
Now, time has come.
With this poison, Luoyang's
lord will be cast into hell!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
现在，时刻到了。
用这毒药，
洛阳的主人将被打入地狱！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
If they lied about my master,
then I'll simply make their lies into truth. Then, my master
won't feel victimized!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
如果他们对我的师父撒谎，
那我就让他们的谎言变成事实。
这样，我的师父就不会感到委屈了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Lord Bai Long!
You will die!
Ha HA HA HA HA!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
白龙大人！
你死定了！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahaha!
Hahaha...Haha..hahaha..haha...hahahahaha...mmmmuhahahahahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
哈哈哈...哈哈...哈哈...哈哈...哈哈哈哈哈...穆哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Muhahahahahaha!
...........
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
穆哈哈哈哈哈！
...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah, forgive me.
I was overly excited.
Yes, I must calm down...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，请原谅我。
我刚才太激动了。
是的，我必须冷静下来...

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I have one last favor to ask of you. Please sneak into the Castle of the Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
现在，我还有一个最后的请求。请潜入龙宫。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
I want you to put this poison some place where Lord Bai Long might stay. But be careful, the castle has a lot of security.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
我要你把这毒药放在白龙大人可能会待的地方。但小心点，龙宫的安保很严密。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Still, you're an adventurer from Midgard. You've probably had challenges like this before, so I'm sure you'll find a way.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不过，你是来自米德加尔特的冒险者。你肯定经历过类似的挑战，我相信你能找到办法。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
总之，我相信我的师父
一定会很高兴知道
我终于制造出了
他想要的^0000FF毒药^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
师父，我做到了！
您的弟子宋志度为您制造出了
世界上最致命的毒药！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Remember...
The Castle of the Dragon
is under heavy surveillance.
I guess Lord Bai Long is
insecure. Heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
记住...
龙宫处于严密的监视之下。
看来白龙大人很没有安全感。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyways, I hope you'll be
really careful. When you go in, don't forget to use this poison somewhere the Lord Bai Long
can ingest it.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
总之，希望你一定要小心。
进去后，别忘了把毒药
放在白龙大人能摄入的地方。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Anyway, I'm sure my master
will be happy to know that
I finally created the ^0000FFpoison
he wished to create^000000!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
总之，我相信我的师父
一定会很高兴知道
我终于制造出了
他想要的^0000FF毒药^000000！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hahaha...!
Master, I did it!
Your disciple Song Zhi Du made the world's deadliest poison for you!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
哈哈哈...！
师父，我做到了！
您的弟子宋志度为您制造出了
世界上最致命的毒药！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Leave now,
my friend!
For my revenge!
Go and kill Lord Bai Long!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
现在去吧，
我的朋友！
为了我的复仇！
去杀了白龙大人！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah!
You came back!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊！
你回来了！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah yes.
All I have to do now
is wait and hear news
of Lord Bai Long's death.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊，是的。
我现在只需要等待
白龙大人死亡的消息了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Thank you so much, my friend. You've satisfied my old grudge.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
非常感谢你，我的朋友。你帮我解开了多年的心结。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I am getting tired.
Let me rest... Take care, my friend, and travel in safety.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
现在，我有些累了。
让我休息一下吧...保重，我的朋友，一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
But before you go, let me give you some poison and a medicinal pill.
I made these with the leftover materials and medicine in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
但在你走之前，让我给你一些毒药和药丸。
我是用仓库里剩下的材料和药材制作的。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Please take the
medicine pill
right away.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
请立刻
服用
这颗药丸。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou swallowed a strange pill
that shines with a gold color.
It tastes bitter...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你吞下了一颗闪烁着金色光芒的奇怪药丸。
味道很苦...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe nasty taste lingers in your mouth, but then you feel a great warmth flowing throughout your body. Eventually, you pass out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF难吃的味道在口中 lingering，但随后你感到一股巨大的暖流流遍全身。最终，你昏了过去。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFSong Zhi Du looks blankly at the ceiling. With his revenge, it seems he's lost his motivation in life. Was it a good idea to help him, after all?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF宋志度呆呆地望着天花板。似乎因为复仇，他失去了生活的动力。当初帮他，真的是个正确的决定吗？^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFBy hearsay, the poisoned drink didn't work so well, as a Thief from a foreign land actually stole the bottle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF据传闻，那杯毒酒并没有奏效，因为一位来自异国的盗贼偷走了那瓶酒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
What happened?
Why isn't
Lord Bai Long dead yet?!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
怎么回事？
为什么白龙大人
还没死？！

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Hmmm...
You don't have
a different plot
in mind, do you?
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
嗯...
你该不会
另有图谋吧？

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Ah...
Welcome.
My master told
me everything.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
啊...
欢迎。
师父把
一切都告诉我了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Somehow, I feel relieved, but sorry at the same time. Still, now I can forget everything that's happened in the past.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
不知为何，我感到既如释重负又有些抱歉。不过，现在我可以忘掉过去发生的一切了。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Now, I've decided to focus more on my medical studies so that I can really save as many lives as I can. I'm sorry I've been so rude to you before.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
现在，我决定更加专注于医学研究，以便真正拯救更多的生命。抱歉我之前对你那么无礼。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Also, I hope you will
take these, since I don't
need them any longer.
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
另外，既然我不再需要这些了，
希望你能收下。

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Thank you
once again, friend.
Now, if you'll excuse me,
I have many things to do...
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
再次
谢谢你，朋友。
那么，失陪了，
我还有很多事要做...

scripts.text: ^3355FFSong Zhi Du is busily engaged with organizing medicinal herbs. The faint look of sadness that used to be on his face now seems drained.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF宋志度正忙着整理草药。他脸上曾经那淡淡的忧伤似乎已经消散了。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFStill, from his movements and the pace at which he is working, you can tell that he loves what he is doing. It seems that Song Zhi Du has finally found his life's path.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不过，从他的动作和工作的节奏来看，可以看出他热爱自己的工作。看来宋志度终于找到了自己的人生道路。^000000

scripts.text:
[Song Zhi Du]
Nagash Arses is also the name of poison king in a legend of Arcturus. There's good reason for my master to be proud of his name!
scripts.translation:
[宋志度]
纳加什·阿尔塞斯也是阿尔克图斯传说中“毒王”的名字。师父对自己的名字感到自豪是有充分理由的！

Currently, you're carrying too many items. Please put some of your things into Kafra Storage and try again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF * 等等！ *
你携带的物品太多了。请将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库，然后重试。^000000

I hope you enjoy
your stay here~
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Lady]
You're at the entrance of Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你正站在洛阳的入口处。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Luoyang is well known
for its various firecrackers.
Would you like to see one?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
洛阳以各种烟花闻名。
你想看一个吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: No thanks~
