scripts.text:
[Lady]
Alright, there you go!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
好了，给你！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmpf...!

[Lady]
Would you
like to see some
firecrackers?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
你想看
烟花吗？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: No thanks~
scripts.translation: 不用了~

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Alright,
there you go!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
好了，给你！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmm, if not firecrackers,
then you must want something
else. Did someone send you?
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嗯，如果不是烟花，
那你一定是想要别的东西。
是有人派你来的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Who was it?
Please tell me
his name.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
是谁？
请告诉我
他的名字。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Oh, I see.
Let me give
you the package.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
哦，我明白了。
让我把包裹
给你。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Ah, wait! I forgot!
You must first pay the
delivery fee of 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
啊，等等！我忘了！
你必须先支付
1,000 Zeny的运费。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Thank you~
Now that the fee is paid,
please bring this to
Song Zhi Du.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
谢谢~
既然运费已经付了，
请把这个交给
宋志度。
再见！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Errr...
You don't have enough zeny for the fee. I can't give you the package unless the delivery fee is paid!
scripts.translation:
[女士]
呃...
你的Zeny不够支付运费。除非支付运费，否则我不能给你包裹！

scripts.text:
[Lady]
Hmmm?
I don't know who that is.
So I definitely don't have
a package for whoever you're
talking about.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
嗯？
我不认识那个人。
所以我肯定没有
给那个人的包裹。

No...?

什么人！

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你尽可能快地逃跑了！^000000

Huh...?
What was
that noise?
scripts.translation:

嗯...？
刚才那是什么

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou bolted away from the castle as fast as your legs could carry you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你以最快的速度逃离了城堡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
Is somebody there?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯...？
那里有人吗？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escaped from the soldier's suspicious gaze.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你逃出了士兵怀疑的目光。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hold it right there, Midgardian!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
站住，米德加德人！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou run as fast as you can before the soldiers can catch you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在士兵追上你之前拼命奔跑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
I hear something!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嗯...？
我听到什么声音了！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escape before the soldier can find you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在士兵发现你之前逃走了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's this?
A crack in the wall?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是什么？
墙上的裂缝？

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou jump to the stone wall and peep into the crack. It looks big enough for someone to squeeze through.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你跳到石墙上，从裂缝里往里看。看起来足够一个人挤过去。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou move through the crack as quickly as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你尽可能快地穿过裂缝。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou found a drink bottle that's possibly owned by Bai Long, lord of Luoyang.^00000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个酒瓶，可能是洛阳之主白龙的所有物。^00000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou put the deadly poison into the bottle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把致命猛毒倒进了瓶子里。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt would be smart to get out of this place as soon as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF尽快离开这个地方比较明智。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou take the drink bottle and replace it with a bottle filled with Sticky Mucus. Hopefully Bai Long won't notice!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿走了酒瓶，并用装满粘稠液体的瓶子替换了它。希望白龙大人不会发现！^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt seems that you need switch Bai Long's drinking bottle with something else. Just taking the drink bottle would arouse suspicion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看来你需要用别的东西替换白龙大人的酒瓶。只拿走酒瓶会引人怀疑。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFMaybe if you found some kind of empty bottle and filled it with something, like Sticky Mucus...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF也许你可以找一个空瓶，里面装些东西，比如粘稠液体...^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou found a drink bottle. It's fancy enough that the only possible owner could be Bai Long, lord of Luoyang.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你发现了一个酒瓶。它很精致，唯一可能的拥有者就是洛阳的白龙大人。^000000

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你尽可能快地挤过裂缝。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Hey...!
You're not doing
anything suspicious
are you?
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
嘿...！
你没有什么
可疑的行为
吧？

scripts.text:

from Bai Long as
fast as you can!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃离了白龙大人！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Hahahaha!
Welcome to Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
哈哈哈！
欢迎来到洛阳！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Luoyang is such a great city.
We've protected this land for forty years from the invasions of evil creatures!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
洛阳是一座伟大的城市。
我们保护这片土地四十年，抵御邪恶生物的入侵！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I hope you enjoy
your stay here,
Midgardian!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
希望你在
这里住得
愉快，米德加德人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give Nagash Arses' Journal
to Bai Long. He reads it intently, slowly turning each page.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你将纳加什·阿尔塞斯的日记交给了白龙大人。他专注地阅读着，缓慢地翻动着每一页。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHe's completely silent for about fifteen minutes, and focuses all
of his attention of the journal.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他沉默了大约十五分钟，全神贯注地注视着这本日记。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFA single tear trickles
from his eye as he reads
the words of Nagash Arse...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF当他读到纳加什·阿尔塞斯写下的文字时，一滴泪水从他的眼角滑落...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you..
Adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
谢谢你...
冒险者...

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you so much.
You've helped me make
up with an old friend!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
非常感谢你。
你帮我与一位老朋友冰释前嫌！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I, Bai Long, will work on giving
fair treatment to all of martial arts organizations, regardless of their methods or philosophies!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
我，白龙，将致力于公平对待所有武术组织，无论他们的方法或理念如何！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I will also forgive Song Zhi Du, even if he tried to poison me.
He is innocent...
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
我也会原谅宋志度，即使他曾试图毒害我。
他是无辜的...

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
As a matter of fact, it was reported to me that Nagash was deported to his homeland after
that incident. I had no idea
he was in jail!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
事实上，有人向我报告说，在那次事件之后，纳加什被遣返回了他的祖国。我完全不知道他是在坐牢！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you so
much for your help!
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
非常感谢你的帮助！

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Please, take this as a token of gratitute. And please deliver this letter to Nagash and Song Zhi Du for me.
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
请收下这个作为谢礼。另外，请帮我把这封信交给纳加什和宋志度。

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou obtained ^0000FFBai Long's letter^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你获得了 ^0000FF白龙大人的信^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
Thank you in advance.
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
先谢过你了。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
How could I have lost my friend from our glory days? Hmm...?
Oh, I didn't realize you were still there... Listening to me.
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
我怎么会失去那位与我共赴辉煌岁月的朋友呢？嗯...？
哦，我都没注意到你还在那里...听我自言自语。

scripts.text:
[Lord Bai Long]
I'm sorry, I was just talking to myself. I hope you have a good time while staying here in Luoyang.
scripts.translation:
[白龙大人]
抱歉，我刚才只是在自言自语。希望你在洛阳期间过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hey...
There's something
fishy about you...!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
嘿...
你看起来有点...
可疑...！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou escaped from the castle, far away from the suspicious guard...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你逃离了城堡，远离了那位可疑的卫兵...^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
^666666*Yawn*^000000 It's so boring here nowadays. Although, I hear that
a long time ago, things were
much different.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
^666666*哈欠*^000000 最近这里真无聊。不过，我听说很久以前，这里的情况大不相同。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Supposedly, monsters used to intrude Luoyang all the time! Heh, but that's just a rumor. Still, there are a bunch of rumors going around that I'm curious about...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
据说，魔物以前经常入侵洛阳！呵，那只是谣言。不过，最近流传着一些让我好奇的传闻...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Huh...?
Is somebody there?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
咦...？
那里有人吗？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away
as quickly
as you could.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃跑了。^000000

scripts.text: Hey, wake up!
scripts.translation: 嘿，醒醒！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Yeeeesss...Sir!
I was not dozing off~ seerious...ly...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
是...是的，长官！
我并没有打瞌睡...真的...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
...

[Soldier]
Huh...?
What was that?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
咦...？
刚才是什么声音？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou escape the soldier's
suspicious gaze as quickly
as you can.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你迅速逃离了士兵怀疑的目光。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
People have been
saying that there's
a scammer at the
entrance of town...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
有人听说，
在城镇入口处
有个骗子...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
But I went there and I didn't
find anyone suspicious. I swear, everything seemed completely normal!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
但我去了那里，并没有发现任何可疑的人。我发誓，一切看起来都很正常！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Who goes there?!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什么人？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou ran away
as quickly
as you could.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你以最快的速度
逃跑了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Ah, don't bother
to listen to this
guy beside of me.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊，别听我旁边
这家伙瞎说。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I hope you have a good time while you're staying here in Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
希望您在我们洛阳停留期间玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Where there's a will,
there's a way. When we
work together, there's
nothing we cannot do.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
有志者事竟成。
当我们齐心协力时，
没有什么事是做不到的。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Will you lend us your power, and help us build a better future? Will you join our movement for social reform in Luoyang?
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你愿意借给我们你的力量，帮助我们建设更美好的未来吗？你愿意加入我们在洛阳的社会改革运动吗？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
It doesn't matter if you're a local or a foreigner. So long as we share the same goal of creating a better Luoyang, where everyone is treated as an equal.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
无论你是当地人还是外地人，只要我们都怀着同一个目标，那就是创造一个更好的洛阳，在那里每个人都被平等对待。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
My name...
is Sun Mao.
This invitation may be sudden, but I am a man of action. I see in your face that you too despise injustice.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
我的名字...
是孙茂。
这份邀请可能有些突然，但我是一个行动派。我从你的脸上看出，你也憎恶邪恶使者。

scripts.text: What am I supposed to do?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么做？

scripts.text: I will join you!
scripts.translation: 我加入你们！

scripts.text: Well, I'm just another tourist...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我只是个游客...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
For now, we must recruit as many members as we can. When we're ready, we'll start a movement that will change Luoyang, and even the world!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
目前，我们必须招募尽可能多的成员。当我们准备就绪时，我们将发起一场改变洛阳，甚至改变世界的运动！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, we currently do not have the manpower to carry out the plans we have laid out. We've been lucky the lord hasn't found us out yet.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
然而，我们目前人手不足，无法执行既定计划。幸运的是，领主还没有发现我们。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I wish everyone would understand our intentions, but the people of this city are disunited. This is not the first time I have approached a foreigner for help...
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
我希望所有人都能理解我们的意图，但这座城市的人们并不团结。这并非我第一次向外来者寻求帮助...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I suppose you understand the urgency of our cause, and our need to gather others who see the merit of our goals!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
我想你应该理解我们事业的紧迫性，以及我们需要召集更多认同我们目标的人！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh, God must be on my side today and has sent you to me. Thank you for making the big decision...
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
噢，看来神明今天站在我这边，派你来到了我面前。谢谢你做出了这个重大决定...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I shall then engrave your name
on this bloody pledge board. But before I do so, I shall ask once more. Do you truly wish to join us, through pain and bloodshed?
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
那么，我将把你的名字刻在这块血誓板上。但在这么做之前，我要再问一次。你真的愿意加入我们，哪怕要经历痛苦和流血吗？

scripts.text: No, wait!
scripts.translation: 不，等等！

scripts.text: I am 100% sure.
scripts.translation: 我百分之百确定。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I understand if you need time to decide. If you do decide to join us, please return. Time is on our side, after all.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
如果你需要时间考虑，我理解。如果你决定加入我们，请回来。毕竟，时间站在我们这边。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
{0}...!
Your name is now engraved on this bloody pledge board. We will fight together to the death for Luoyang's future!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
{0}...！
你的名字现在已刻在这块血誓板上。我们将为洛阳的未来并肩战斗至死！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, the most important thing for our cause is to gather more recruits and increase our numbers. Please find others who will join us in our fight.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
现在，对我们事业最重要的是招募更多成员，壮大我们的队伍。请去寻找其他愿意加入战斗的人。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, as to not arouse suspicion, bring only one new recruit at a time. Also, we suggest not to bring a friend in a party with you.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
不过，为了不引起怀疑，每次只带一名新成员。另外，我们建议不要带朋友组队同行。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, I will wait for you here. Go forth and find others who wish for a better future for Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
现在，我会在这里等你。去吧，去寻找那些希望洛阳拥有更美好未来的人！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please assist the people who fight behind you. As more are gathered, one of our comrades will inform you of further instructions.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请协助那些在你身后战斗的人。随着人数增加，我们的同志会向你传达进一步的指示。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Are you...? I see, you may leave now. Do not reveal what you have seen or heard in this place.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你是...？我明白了，你可以离开了。不要泄露你在这里看到或听到的任何事。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
If you're a real tourist, you do not want to get involved in our business, one way or another.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
如果你真的是个游客，就不想以任何方式卷入我们的事务。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Once again,
thank you for
your trouble.
Go back safe.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
再次感谢你的配合。
请安全回去。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh, you brought a new comrade! Welcome. Please help your friend understand our intentions before joining us.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
噢，你带来了一位新同志！欢迎。请在加入我们之前，帮助你的朋友理解我们的意图。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please bring another friend that both of you can trust. Remember, add one person at a time into your party.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请再带一位你们两人都信任的朋友。记住，每次只向队伍中添加一个人。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
The three of you may all move together for our cause. Please try to find another recruit to be your fourth member, invite him to your party and bring him to this place.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你们三人可以一起为我们的事业行动。请尝试再找一名招募对象作为你们的第四名成员，邀请他加入队伍并带到这个地方。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Ah, now there are four of you. However, we must continue to strengthen our ranks at a cautious pace. Please go and find one new recruit, and only one, to add to your party.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
啊，现在你们有四个人了。然而，我们必须谨慎地继续壮大队伍。请去寻找一名新招募对象，且只能是一名，加入你们的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, there are five of you. Needless to say, we still require more manpower. Please go out and seek another new member for our cause. Remember, only add one more person to your party and return to me.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
现在你们有五个人了。不用说，我们仍然需要更多的人手。请出去为我们的事业再寻找一名新成员。记住，只向队伍中添加一个人，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
There are now six of you. So far, so good. Please go forth and find just one more person to add to your party and bring him to me so that we may recruit him.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
现在你们有六个人了。目前进展顺利。请再去找一个人加入队伍，并把他带到我这里，以便我们招募他。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Now, there are seven of you, but we still lack the manpower we need. Please go forth and seek out one, and only one, more person to add to your party and then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
现在你们有七个人了，但我们仍然缺乏所需的人手。请再去找一个人，且只能是一个人，加入队伍，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
[Sun Mao]
Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
干得好，你又带来了一位新同志！欢迎！请向我们的新朋友解释我们的目标以及我们事业的正义性，以便他能完全加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Otherwise, other people may learn of what we are doing, and that will lead to trouble.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
否则，其他人可能会得知我们在做什么，那将会带来麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Great work, you've brought another new comrade! Welcome! Please explain our goals and the righteousness of our cause to our new friend so that he may fully join us.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
干得好，你又带来了一位新同志！欢迎！请向我们的新朋友解释我们的目标以及我们事业的正义性，以便他能完全加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
It is almost time to take the action...
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
是时候采取行动了...

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I recognize your pledge to fight for us, but I fear that you are not yet ready for the task I have available for you.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
我认可你们为我们战斗的承诺，但我担心你们还没有准备好接受我分配的任务。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
However, we still have time. Go out and train with the party members you have gathered to gain more experience.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
不过，我们还有时间。出去和你召集的队伍成员一起训练，以获取更多的经验。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Together, all of you will be able to train faster than if you were to go train alone. Come back when you feel that you are ready for this task.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
大家一起训练，会比单独训练更快。当你觉得准备好接受这个任务时，再回来。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At long last, there are eight of you. Now, I believe there is among manpower amongst you to carry out this mission. Please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
终于，你们有八个人了。现在，我相信你们之中有足够的人手来执行这项任务。请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
The martial arts organizations of Luoyang, as you may well know, have been divided between those that fight for justice, and those that serve evil purposes.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
正如你们所知，洛阳的武术组织已经分裂，一部分为正义而战，另一部分则服务于邪恶的目的。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Recently, some of the evil organizations have conspired with corrupt government officials in the interest to expand their power.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
最近，一些邪恶组织与腐败的政府官员勾结，以扩大他们的权力。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
These corrupt government officials have been suspicious of our gunpowder research and arrested our comrade, ^3355FFHao Chenryu^000000, our gunpowder expert, under the pretext of investigation.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
这些腐败的政府官员对我们的火药研究感到怀疑，并以调查为借口逮捕了我们的同志，^3355FF郝辰宇^000000，我们的火药专家。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Without him, we cannot continue the gunpowder research, or produce the gunpowder we'll need for our movement. We must contact him so that he may make gunpowder for us.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
没有他，我们无法继续火药研究，也无法生产我们运动所需的火药。我们必须联系他，让他为我们制造火药。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Unfortunately, many of us cannot contact him, as our identities are known to the officials. However, since you are new recruits, as well as Midgardians, they will not know how you are.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
不幸的是，我们中的许多人无法联系他，因为我们的身份已被官员知晓。然而，由于你们是新的招募对象，也是米德加尔德人，他们不会知道你们的样子。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Your mission will be to deliver these chemicals to our comrade Hao Chenryu who is held captive by the government.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你们的任务是将这些化学品送到被政府囚禁的我们的同志郝辰宇手中。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Since flammable chemicals are not allowed inside government offices, you must keep them well hidden. If the chemicals are equally divided among the eight of you, we might succeed!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
由于易燃化学品不允许进入政府办公室，你们必须将它们藏好。如果这些化学品在你们八个人之间平均分配，我们可能会成功！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
There you go. Now, divide these materials equally among the eight of you. The eight of you must fully cooperate with each other, or our plan will fail. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
给你。现在，将这些材料在你们八个人之间平均分配。你们八个人必须完全合作，否则我们的计划就会失败。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
You made a party. Now, why don't you go recruit more followers? For now, just add one more person, lest we arouse the suspicion of our enemies.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你们组建了一支队伍。现在，为什么不去招募更多的信徒呢？暂时只再添加一个人，以免引起敌人的怀疑。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a third person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
嗯...
在寻找加入队伍的第三个人时遇到困难了吗？找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding a forth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
嗯...
在寻找加入队伍的第四个人时遇到困难了吗？我理解找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a fifth person to add to your party? I understand that it's important that you find someone you can trust. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
在寻找加入队伍的第五个人时遇到困难了吗？我理解找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a six person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
在寻找加入队伍的第六个人时遇到困难了吗？找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Having trouble finding a seventh person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
在寻找加入队伍的第七个人时遇到困难了吗？找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hmmm...
Having trouble finding an eighth person to add to your party? It's important that you find someone that is trustworthy. Be careful and don't get caught!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
嗯...
在寻找加入队伍的第八个人时遇到困难了吗？找到值得信赖的人很重要。小心行事，别被抓住了！

scripts.text: [Sun Mao]
scripts.translation: [孙茂]

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Oh no! You've brought more than one more person to join us! We can't do any recruiting now, it will bring unnecessary attention to our activities!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
糟糕！你们带的人比计划中多了一个！我们现在不能进行招募了，这会引起不必要的注意！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of two members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请确保队伍中总共有两名成员，这样我们才能招募你的朋友。我相信这样看起来会比较自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of three members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
在我们计划的这个阶段，我们不能承受任何不必要的注意！请确保队伍中总共有三名成员，这样我们才能招募你的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of four members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请确保队伍中总共有四名成员，这样我们才能招募你的朋友。我相信这样看起来会比较自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please make sure that there is a total of five members in your party so that we can recruit your friend. I believe that will look natural.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请确保队伍中总共有五名成员，这样我们才能招募你的朋友。我相信这样看起来会比较自然。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
By this time, you should know that you should only bring one more person at a time. You know that it is crucial that we do not attract any undue attention before we can take action!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
到了这个时候，你应该知道每次只能多带一个人。你知道在我们采取行动之前，不引起任何不当注意是多么关键！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
At this stage in our plan, we cannot afford any unnecessary attention to our activities! Please make sure that there is a total of eight members in your party so that we can recruit your friend.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
在我们计划的这个阶段，我们不能承受任何不必要的注意！请确保队伍中总共有八名成员，这样我们才能招募你的朋友。

scripts.text: [Sun Mao]
scripts.translation: [孙茂]

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Welcome back! I see that the mission has been successfully accomplished! Great work, men!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
欢迎回来！看来任务已经成功完成了！干得好，伙计们！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Finally, we have a weapon to mete out severe retribution to our enemies, the corrupt government officials and the evil martial arts organizations! I appreciate your help, comrades.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
终于，我们有了武器，可以对腐败的政府官员和邪恶的武术组织进行严厉的报复！感谢你们的帮助，同志们。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Please take these funds and share them with your party members. I hope that all of you will lend your power to our cause once again.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
请收下这些资金，并与你的队伍成员分享。我希望你们所有人都能再次为我们的事业贡献力量。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Once again, I thank you for your help. Now, go in safety.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
再次感谢你们的帮助。现在，请安全离开。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Your mission is to take the materials I have given you and your party members, and to smuggle them to Hao Chenryu.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
你们的任务是带着我给你的材料和你队伍成员的材料，将它们走私给郝辰宇。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Hao Chenryu is currently held captive by corrupt members of the government. Remember to divide the materials equally among your party members so that the officials do find them.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
郝辰宇目前被腐败的政府成员囚禁。记得将材料在队伍成员之间平均分配，以免被官员发现。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Huh, where are all your members? Come back to me with all of your recruits.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
嗯，你的成员们呢？
带着你所有的招募人员回来见我。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Remember that you move together with your comrades. There isn't a traitor amongst you, is there?
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
记住，你要与你的同志们一起行动。
你们中间没有叛徒吧？

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Ah...
You have
returned!
Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
啊...
你回来了！
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
I would like to commend you and your comrades for your excellent performance in the last mission. Come back anytime if you wish to be assigned to another task for our cause.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
我要表扬你和你的同志们在上一项任务中的出色表现。
如果你们想为我们的事业接受新的任务，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Sun Mao]
Remember that the authoritative center of the party is its leader. The party members must act as one in order to accomplish their goals.
scripts.translation:
[孙茂]
记住，队伍的核心权威是首领。
队伍成员必须团结一致，才能达成目标。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Who...
Are you?
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
你...
是谁？

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I only trust my comrades in the cause for Luoyang, so leave me alone. Death before oppression! Freedom for Luoyang!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
我只信任为洛阳事业奋斗的同志们，所以请别打扰我。
宁死不屈！洛阳自由！

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Mao told me that eight Midgardians
would be coming.
But what happened?
I'm confused...
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
茂告诉我会有八个米德加德人过来。
但发生了什么？
我很困惑...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Mao's plans are flawless,
so I'm sticking to the scenario he's drawn up. You're either improvising needlessly, or you're not really my comrade...
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
茂的计划是无懈可击的，
所以我坚持按照他制定的方案行事。你要么是在不必要的即兴发挥，要么你根本不是我的同志...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Ah, I see that Mao
has sent you. I'm sorry
for the trouble you've
gone through to smuggle
the chemicals to me, comrade.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
啊，我明白了，
是茂派你来的。很抱歉，
让你费心为我走私这些化学品，同志。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Please give me
a minute so that
I may quickly make
the gunpowder.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
请给我一分钟，
让我快速制作
火药。

scripts.text: Make Gunpowder.
scripts.translation: 制作火药

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I don't want you to be caught if the soldiers inspect your goods. It will be better if one of you carry a Cart and hide the gunpowder in there.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
如果士兵检查你们的货物，我不想让你被抓。
最好由你们其中一人租用手推车，把火药藏在里面。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Is...
Something wrong?!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
怎...
怎么了？！

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I guess we must
be extra careful,
as there is much
surveillance in
this place.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
看来我们必须格外小心，
因为这里有很多
监视。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Hmmm...
It seems like
you're one of us.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
嗯...
看来你是我们
自己人。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
If you came for the
gunpowder, you should
get some chemcials
from your party leader.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
如果你是来取火药的，
你应该从你的队伍首领那里
拿一些化学品。

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
Be careful!
It's easy for
gunpowder to be
found during the
inspection process!
Hide it well...!
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
小心！
火药很容易在
检查过程中被发现！
藏好它...

scripts.text:
[Hao Chenryu]
I hope you bring the gunpowder to Mao safely. The next time you see him, please give him my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[郝辰宇]
希望你能安全地把火药带给茂。下次见到他时，请转达我的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Hold on there!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
You're not allowed to bring any gunpowder out of here. Now go
and put it back, Midgardian! Move!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你不准把火药带出去。现在，把它放回去，米德加德人！快走！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
It's strange to see outsiders in this kind of place. We don't have any business with you,
so move along.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
在这种地方看到外人真是奇怪。我们和你没有生意往来，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I am sorry, but it is prohibited to enter with some of the products
you are carrying. I cannot let you in.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
很抱歉，你携带的部分物品禁止带入。我不能让你进去。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
There is nothing much, but if you wish to look around this room, please be my guest.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
这里没什么特别的，但如果你想四处看看，请便。
